scenes.title: ETH Zurich master's: the window closes 30 November.
scenes.say: Planning a master's at E T H Zurich? The window closes on the thirtieth of November.

scenes.title: One window, 1 to 30 November 2026
scenes.body: Everyone with a non-Swiss bachelor's applies for Autumn 2027 in this window.
scenes.say: If your bachelor's is not from a Swiss university, you apply for autumn twenty twenty-seven between the first and the thirtieth of November.

scenes.title: ESOP is in the same window
scenes.body: Want the Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme? Apply in this window too.
scenes.say: If you want the Excellence Scholarship and Opportunity Programme, you must apply in this same window.

scenes.title: Deadline: 30 Nov, 11:59 CET
scenes.body: Late or incomplete applications can't be processed.
scenes.say: The deadline is Monday the thirtieth of November, at eleven fifty-nine in the morning, Central European Time. Late or incomplete applications can't be processed.
